svg.aria-label: Cheating pays in 107 of 300 states; whether it pays depends on tourist share, enforcement and liability together; 98 close calls.
svg.text: Whether cheating pays now turns on more than who checks
Best cheating option minus staying honest, remaining profit as a share of honest's, per state; 300 states, 107 pay, 98 close calls (red)
Bazaar Markets engine 1.2.0, state bank v2 (runs/state_bank_v2/states.jsonl.gz): 24 markets, seeds 600–699, days 5–20. Dots: mean over K = 20 paired continuations;
lines: 95% t intervals, unadjusted; open circles: beyond the axis. Unweighted; 176 states come from one stratum (40% tourists, full enforcement).
